title: The intersection of coefficient subrings is the pth-power image
statement: Let p be prime, k a field of characteristic p, and (t_i) indexed by I a p-basis of k over k^p. Let n,m be nonnegative integers and A = k[[x_1,...,x_n]][y_1,...,y_m]. For each finite J in I, let kJ be the subfield generated by k^p and the t_i outside J, and AJ the subring defined exactly by coefficients in kJ and nonzero coefficients only at p-divisible x and y exponents. For every f in A, f belongs to every AJ if and only if f = h^p for some h in A. The power-series and polynomial rings are [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] and [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], and p-basis means the bounded monomials form a basis as in [def-weil-pbc-free-module].

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07P5 (lemma-power-series-ring-subfields, line 11521) and its proof; properties (2)-(4) are conditions (1)-(3) of Lemma Tag 07P4 (lemma-intersection-subfields), written out; tags verified in stacks-project/tags/tags

proof.text: As in parent step 3(a), kJ is the k^p-span of bounded p-basis monomials avoiding J: closure under products follows by exponent reduction, and closure under inverse by finite-dimensional multiplication on the generators occurring in an element. For c in every kJ, take J to contain the supports of its finitely many p-basis coordinates. Coordinate uniqueness forces every nonconstant coordinate to vanish. Therefore the intersection of the kJ is k^p. The declaration docstring gives the full argument.

If f belongs to every AJ, each coefficient belongs to k^p and every nonzero exponent is p-divisible. At (pa,pg), take the unique pth root of the coefficient to construct a power series for each y-column g. Only finitely many y-columns are nonzero, so these give an actual h in A. The coefficientwise Frobenius formula and finite-sum Frobenius identity give h^p=f. Conversely these identities put every h^p in every AJ. No bounded support in the power-series variables is assumed.

theorem powerSeriesSubringIntersection
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k p]
    (I : Type w) (t : I → k)
    (hpb : ∃ b : Module.Basis
      {E : I →₀ ℕ // ∀ i : I, E i < p}
      (IntermediateField.adjoin (ZMod p) (Set.range (fun x : k => x ^ p))) k,
      ∀ E, b E = (E : I →₀ ℕ).prod (fun i e => t i ^ e))
    (n m : ℕ) (kJ : Finset I → Subfield k)
    (hkJ : ∀ J, kJ J = Subfield.closure
      (Set.range (fun x : k => x ^ p) ∪ {x : k | ∃ i : I, i ∉ J ∧ t i = x}))
    (AJ : Finset I → Subring (MvPolynomial (Fin m) (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k)))
    (hAJ : ∀ J f, f ∈ AJ J ↔
      ∀ (a : Fin n →₀ ℕ) (g : Fin m →₀ ℕ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff a (MvPolynomial.coeff g f) ∈ kJ J ∧
        (MvPowerSeries.coeff a (MvPolynomial.coeff g f) ≠ 0 →
          (∀ i, p ∣ a i) ∧ (∀ j, p ∣ g j))) :
    ∀ f : MvPolynomial (Fin m) (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k),
      (∀ J, f ∈ AJ J) ↔ ∃ h, h ^ p = f
